title: Motorcycle Touring, Ergonomics & Premium Protective Gear (CE Armor & Airbag Vests)
description: High-register motorcycle touring English module examining European ECE 22.06 helmet standards, autonomous electronic airbag deployment, and ergonomic aerodynamics.
learning_objectives: Master protective gear terminology (ECE 22.06 homologation, D3O non-Newtonian armor, electronic airbag vest, Cordura, pannier balance)
Apply participial clauses and concession structures to technical gear reviews and purchasing decisions
Demonstrate fluency when debating long-distance touring ergonomics, windscreen aerodynamics, and luggage load distribution

questions.prompt: _____ the long-distance touring rider not worn an autonomous electronic airbag vest, the direct impact with the guardrail would have caused severe fractures.

explanations.correct: Inverted Third Conditional 'Had the touring rider not worn...' correctly expresses a past counterfactual premise without 'if'.
explanations.wrong_A: 'If' requires the auxiliary 'had' after the subject.
explanations.wrong_C: 'Were' forms a Second Conditional, incompatible with past 'would have caused'.

questions.cz_learning_point: Inverze 3. kondicionálu: 'Had the rider not worn...' = 'Kdyby jezdec neměl na sobě...'. V podmínce se nepoužívá 'if' ani 'would'.

questions.prompt: Rarely _____ standard denim jeans provide adequate slide abrasion resistance beyond two seconds of sliding across high-friction tarmac.

explanations.correct: Negative adverb 'Rarely' triggers subject-auxiliary inversion with plural auxiliary 'do': 'Rarely do standard denim jeans provide...'.
explanations.wrong_B: 'is' is singular and cannot agree with plural 'jeans'.
explanations.wrong_C: 'will' changes the sentence to predictive future rather than an established physical fact.

questions.cz_learning_point: Záporné příslovce 'Rarely' na začátku věty vyžaduje inverzi pomocného slovesa 'do' (množné číslo u jeans) a podmětu: 'Rarely do jeans provide...'.

questions.prompt: If the traveler had balanced the pannier weight distribution evenly last night, the motorcycle _____ at highway cruising speeds today.

explanations.correct: Mixed conditional: past cause ('had balanced') with present ongoing result ('today') takes 'would not be weaving'.
explanations.wrong_B: 'would not have weaved' refers purely to past result, but adverbial 'today' anchors consequence to the present.
explanations.wrong_C: 'will not weave' is First Conditional, incompatible with past counterfactual condition.
explanations.wrong_D: Simple present indicative 'does not weave' cannot express hypothetical consequence.

questions.cz_learning_point: Smíšený kondicionál: minulá příčina spojená s přítomným následkem: 'If he had balanced [minulost], it would not be weaving [dnes]'.

questions.prompt: European ECE 22.06 safety regulations mandate that all motorcycle helmet visors _____ high-velocity steel ball penetration without shattering.

explanations.correct: Mandative subjunctive after 'mandate that' requires base form 'withstand' regardless of plural subject.
explanations.wrong_A: Indicative 'withstands' with 3rd person -s is ungrammatical with plural 'visors' and violates subjunctive syntax.
explanations.wrong_B: Future 'will withstand' is incorrect after mandative 'mandate that'.

questions.cz_learning_point: Subjunktiv po slovesech předpisů (mandate that helmet visors withstand): sloveso zůstává v základním tvaru bez -s.

questions.prompt: _____ the touring windscreen to the optimal aerodynamic height, the rider eliminated fatiguing turbulent helmet buffeting.

explanations.correct: Perfect active participle 'Having adjusted' correctly expresses prior windscreen alignment leading to subsequent quiet cruising.
explanations.wrong_A: Base verb 'Adjust' cannot function as introductory participle.
explanations.wrong_B: Past form 'Adjusted' without auxiliary is passive, but the rider actively adjusted the windscreen.
explanations.wrong_D: 'Being adjusted' expresses present passive, not completed prior action.

questions.cz_learning_point: Předpřítomné participium (Having adjusted = poté, co seřídil...) vyjadřuje děj dokončený před hlavní větou.

questions.prompt: _____ aggressive racing clip-on handlebars offer superior track feedback, upright adventure ergonomics are vastly superior for 800-km riding days.

explanations.correct: 'Although' is a conjunction followed by a full clause with subject and verb ('aggressive racing clip-on handlebars offer...').
explanations.wrong_A: 'In spite of' is a preposition and must be followed by a noun phrase or gerund.
explanations.wrong_C: 'Notwithstanding' is followed by a noun phrase.
explanations.wrong_D: 'Despite' is a preposition and cannot be followed directly by a finite clause.

questions.cz_learning_point: Spojka 'Although' (ačkoli) se pojí s celou větou s podmětem a slovesem, zatímco předložky jako 'Despite' a 'In spite of' vyžadují podstatné jméno.

questions.prompt: Non-Newtonian D3O smart armor polymer is verified _____ flexible during normal movement while instantly stiffening on sudden impact.

explanations.correct: Infinitive 'to remain' correctly expresses the verified physical characteristic of non-Newtonian polymer armor.
explanations.wrong_B: Participle 'remaining' cannot follow passive reporting verb 'is verified'.
explanations.wrong_C: 'to have been remained' is ungrammatical; 'remain' is intransitive and cannot form a passive.

questions.cz_learning_point: Vazba 'is verified to remain flexible' (je ověřeno, že zůstává pružný) vyjadřuje stálou vlastnost materiálu.

questions.prompt: Seldom _____ dual-sport 50/50 adventure tires achieve both quiet highway cruising and aggressive muddy trail traction.

explanations.correct: Negative adverb 'Seldom' triggers subject-auxiliary inversion with Present Simple auxiliary 'do': 'Seldom do adventure tires achieve...'.
explanations.wrong_B: 'did' is past tense, inappropriate for general physical tire characteristics.
explanations.wrong_C: 'were' would form an ungrammatical passive construction.

questions.cz_learning_point: Záporné příslovce 'Seldom' na začátku věty vyžaduje přísnou inverzi: 'Seldom do adventure tires achieve...'.

questions.prompt: With both panniers packed heavily above the center of gravity, the motorcycle's high-speed stability _____ compromised.

explanations.correct: 'Cannot fail to be' expresses inevitable, unavoidable consequence based on the laws of physics.
explanations.wrong_A: 'must to be' is ungrammatical; modals never take 'to'.
explanations.wrong_B: 'can to be' is ungrammatical in English.

questions.cz_learning_point: Formální vazba vyjadřující nevyhnutelný následek: 'cannot fail to be compromised' (nevyhnutelně musí být narušena).

questions.prompt: High-end adventure motorcycles feature a remote hydraulic preload adjuster, by means of _____ the rider compensates for passenger and luggage weight.

explanations.correct: Formal prepositional relative phrase 'by means of which' takes 'which' when modifying a hydraulic adjuster mechanism.
explanations.wrong_A: 'that' cannot follow a preposition in formal relative clauses.

questions.cz_learning_point: Po formálních předložkových vazbách v rozvitých vztažných větách se používá výhradně 'which': 'by means of which' (pomocí něhož).
